sign_new.Aries: a fresh start that rewards courage and a first move
sign_new.Taurus: steady intentions about money, the body and what lasts
sign_new.Gemini: new conversations, learning and ideas worth following up
sign_new.Cancer: home, family and the need to feel safe
sign_new.Leo: creative work, play and being seen for what is yours
sign_new.Virgo: routines, health and the useful work of getting organised
sign_new.Libra: partnership, fairness and finding balance with others
sign_new.Scorpio: deep change, shared resources and what you are ready to transform
sign_new.Sagittarius: the bigger picture: travel, study, belief and aim
sign_new.Capricorn: long-range goals, structure and patient ambition
sign_new.Aquarius: friends, community and the future you want to help build
sign_new.Pisces: rest, intuition, imagination and letting go of control

sign_full.Aries: independence against partnership, and the anger or impatience that has built up
sign_full.Taurus: security and worth: what sustains you, and what you have been clinging to
sign_full.Gemini: facts versus beliefs, with news, talk and realisations coming to light
sign_full.Cancer: home against work, and feelings and family patterns that have been building
sign_full.Leo: your own voice against the group, with recognition and pride at stake
sign_full.Virgo: order against surrender: health, work and the details you have been avoiding
sign_full.Libra: relationships and what has gone out of balance in them
sign_full.Scorpio: trust, intimacy and shared money, with buried truths surfacing
sign_full.Sagittarius: meaning and honesty: what you believe versus what the facts say
sign_full.Capricorn: duty and ambition against home and feeling, with results now visible
sign_full.Aquarius: the group and your ideals against the personal, with a need for room
sign_full.Pisces: dreams, compassion and endings, asking what to forgive and release

planet_hard.mercury: so plans and messages need a second look before they are final
planet_hard.venus: putting relationships, money and self-worth under strain
planet_hard.mars: raising tempers, urgency and the risk of acting too fast
planet_hard.saturn: adding delay, duty and a reality check that tests commitment
planet_hard.uranus: bringing surprises, restlessness and sudden changes of course
planet_hard.neptune: blurring facts with wishful thinking, so confusion and deception are possible
planet_hard.pluto: forcing power issues and deep, sometimes compulsive change into the open
planet_hard.chiron: touching an old wound that asks for healing rather than defence

planet_soft.mercury: helping clear thinking, talks and decisions
planet_soft.venus: easing relationships, money matters and pleasure
planet_soft.mars: giving energy, drive and the confidence to act
planet_soft.jupiter: bringing optimism, luck and room to grow
planet_soft.saturn: lending patience, structure and staying power
planet_soft.pluto: giving depth, focus and the power to transform

planet_conjunct.mercury: putting communication, news and decisions at the centre
planet_conjunct.venus: putting love, money and what you value at the centre
planet_conjunct.mars: charging it with drive, courage and a short fuse
planet_conjunct.jupiter: amplifying everything: optimism, excess and opportunity
planet_conjunct.saturn: making it serious, with commitments, limits and hard work in view
planet_conjunct.uranus: making it unpredictable, with sudden insights and breaks from routine
planet_conjunct.neptune: making it dreamy and uncertain, with intuition up and clarity down
planet_conjunct.pluto: making it intense, with power, endings and rebirth in play
planet_conjunct.chiron: making it tender, with a core wound and its healing in focus

node.north: a North Node eclipse, which pushes toward new ground and growth
node.south: a South Node eclipse, which clears out the past and asks for release

eclipse.solar: A solar eclipse is a wild-card New Moon: doors open and close faster than usual, so set intentions lightly.
eclipse.lunar: A lunar eclipse is a Full Moon with the volume turned up: something completes or comes to light, and the right response is to let it.

timing.new: Intentions set in the day or two after the New Moon run until the next New Moon.
timing.full: Its effects are strongest in the two or three days around the exact Full Moon and resolve over the following two weeks.
timing.eclipse: Its themes unfold over about six months.
